title: Italian Suppli
description: A hearty Italian snack filled with juicy mozzarella and crispy on the outside. Perfect for a quick bite.

ingredients.name: Bread
ingredients.notes: Italian bread, cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Add a pinch of salt for flavor

instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
2. In a large bowl, combine the bread, mozzarella, ricotta, parmesan, and pistachio.
3. Mix well until everything is fully incorporated.
4. Cover the mixture and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
5. Using your hands, shape the mixture into small balls.
6. Dip each ball into the beaten egg, then roll in the bread crumbs to coat.
7. Fry the suppli in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
8. Remove the suppli from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
